fixtures.summary: One board, one button, one baked image, one baked Opus clip.
Three boards: a root with two load_board buttons, and :home back from each.
Archive member name is NFD; the manifest and board refer to it in NFC. The importer must still find the image.
Append, :speak, :clear, :backspace, and one ext_lautstark_speak_immediately button. German content, umlauts and eszett included.
Three buttons with actions outside the mandatory set, including a v1-out-of-scope spelling button.
One button with no sound at all, one whose sound file is absent from the zip, one WAV in the tolerated format.
Unknown ext_lautstark_*, the talker's ext_vorlaut_*, a foreign vendor's fields, and unknown plain OBF fields.
A structurally valid package whose central directory signature has been overwritten.
One image at 2048x2048 (over the 1024 cap), one at 512, and one whose declared size lies.
Package B: the same name as A, a different id. Must not replace A.
The same id as identity-a with a later modified timestamp. Must replace A, not sit beside it.
Six warnings across three boards, in the one order SPEC.md 9.5 allows.
ext_lautstark_first_column_gap on a package whose leftmost column repeats across both boards.
